title: W4 H5 -- editor.css hover rules onto the shared emphasis
description: Follow-up to H4 (T178): in src/editor/editor.css, .prose-issue-dismiss:hover (underline, ~line 79) and .footnote-source:hover (accent, ~line 663) predate the one emphasis rule. Decide per rule: drop the local hover and let the shared block (src/styles.css 'Text-control emphasis', stroke + 1.04 scale; add to catch-all via .text-action or selector if they are not button/a[href]) apply, or document why they stay (inline document text: never rewrite document typography). Check with the crawler (tests/hover-emphasis.spec.ts) and src/hoverEmphasis.test.ts. Starts only after G3 (T176) releases editor.css.

review.note: Diff is two local hover/focus rules removed from editor.css; both elements are plain buttons so the shared emphasis rule applies; hoverEmphasis+designTokens vitest pass for me. Caveat: the crawl test could not confirm it (it hangs on the current tree, see my T178 rejection) so visual effect on these two buttons is unverified by crawl; re-check after T178 is fixed. CLAIMED only.

log.note: Removed .prose-issue-dismiss:hover/:focus-visible (colour+underline) and .footnote-source:hover/:focus-visible (accent colour) from src/editor/editor.css; both are plain <button>s not in the exclusion list, so the shared Text-control emphasis applies. Footnote-source reveal-on-row-hover opacity kept (visibility, not emphasis). Checks: vitest src/hoverEmphasis.test.ts 5 pass; playwright hover-emphasis H2 + H4 pass (2/2) on a fresh build. The slow 'hover inventory crawl' test (20 min timeout) was not run to completion (killed after ~15 min, no asserts). Only before-state was not run fail-first (CSS deletion; no new assertions). CLAIMED.
